tools.name: check_numbers
tools.description: Check every number in an AI-written document against its sources. Each source is a URL (http:// or https://) or pasted source text; at most 3. Returns a one-line summary and the claim ledger: each numeric claim labelled SUPPORTED, MISMATCH or UNSUPPORTED with the source span. Set share=true for a pu

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_numbers · Private data: check_numbers · Public sink: check_numbers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_numbers · Private data: check_numbers · Public sink: check_numbers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
